slides.headline: He's watching his palm. Not his pockets.
slides.sub: Georges de La Tour, The Fortune Teller, 1630s

slides.headline: A rich young man stops to hear his *fortune*.
The old fortune teller holds his gaze and keeps him *talking*.
He looks amused. He has no idea what is *happening*.
On the left, a young woman quietly lifts his *purse*.
Behind his back, another hand waits to take the *purse*.
A coin in his palm keeps his eyes on *her*.
In the middle, a pale girl stays very close, saying *nothing*.
Lower down, scissors quietly snip his gold *chain*.
His gold medal hangs loose, about to *vanish*.
Found in France, bought by the Met. Some still *question* it.
Four women, one victim. Would *you* have noticed?
